inductive CheckRequest where
 | embedding (T : Tree) (P : List (List Nat))
 | restriction (T S : Tree) (B : List Nat)
 deriving Repr,DecidableEq

def checkValue : CheckRequest→Bool
 | .embedding T P=>pairwiseEmbeddings T P

def checkValue : CheckRequest→Bool
 | .embedding T P=>pairwiseEmbeddings T P
 | .restriction T S B=>restrictionAgrees T S B

structure CheckReceipt (α : Type) where
 value : α
 work : Nat

def checkMeter (fee : CheckRequest→Nat) (r : CheckRequest) : CheckReceipt Bool := ⟨checkValue r,fee r,[r]⟩

def andSequence : List (Unit→CheckReceipt Bool)→CheckReceipt Bool
 | []=>⟨true,1,[]⟩
 | f::fs=>let a:=f ()
           if a.value then let b:=andSequence fs
            ⟨b.value,a.work+b.work+a.calls.length+1,a.calls++b.calls⟩

def CheckDomain (N L : Nat) : CheckRequest→Prop
 | .embedding T P=> (leaves T).length≤N ∧ P.length≤2*N+1 ∧ P.flatten.length≤payloadCap N+N ∧
    (∀x,x∈leaves T →x<2^L) ∧ (∀x,x∈P.flatten →x<2^L)
 | .restriction T S B=> (leaves T).length≤N ∧ (leaves S).length≤N ∧ B.length≤N ∧
    (∀x,x∈leaves T →x<2^L) ∧ (∀x,x∈leaves S →x<2^L) ∧ (∀x,x∈B →x<2^L)

def meterRestrictionAgrees (T S : Tree) (B : List Nat) : Charged Bool :=
 let a:=meterRestrict B T;let b:=meterRestrict B S
 match a.value,b.value with
 | some u,some v=>let c:=meterSameShape u v;⟨c.value,a.work+b.work+c.work+4⟩
 | _,_=>⟨false,a.work+b.work+4⟩

@[simp] theorem meterRestrictionAgrees_value (T S : Tree) (B : List Nat) :

@[simp] theorem meterRestrictionAgrees_value (T S : Tree) (B : List Nat) :
 (meterRestrictionAgrees T S B).value=restrictionAgrees T S B := by
 cases ht : restrict B T <;> cases hs : restrict B S <;>
  simp [meterRestrictionAgrees,restrictionAgrees,meterRestrict_value,ht,hs]

theorem meterRestrictionAgrees_bound (T S : Tree) (B : List Nat) (N : Nat)
 (tn : treeNodes T≤2*N) (sn : treeNodes S≤2*N) (bl : B.length≤N) :

theorem meterRestrictionAgrees_bound (T S : Tree) (B : List Nat) (N : Nat)
 (tn : treeNodes T≤2*N) (sn : treeNodes S≤2*N) (bl : B.length≤N) :
 (meterRestrictionAgrees T S B).work≤128*(N+1)^2 := by
 have a:=meterRestrict_bound B T
 have b:=meterRestrict_bound B S
 have ea:=Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 4 (Nat.add_le_add_right bl 2)) tn
 have eb:=Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 4 (Nat.add_le_add_right bl 2)) sn

def meterPairwise (T : Tree) : Forest → Charged Bool
 | []=>⟨true,1⟩
 | B::F=>let a:=meterAll (meterHullPair T B) F;let r:=meterPairwise T F
         ⟨a.value&&r.value,a.work+r.work+4⟩
@[simp] theorem meterPairwise_value (T F) : (meterPairwise T F).value=pairwiseEmbeddings T F := by
 induction F with
 | nil=>rfl

@[simp] theorem meterPairwise_value (T F) : (meterPairwise T F).value=pairwiseEmbeddings T F := by
 induction F with
 | nil=>rfl
 | cons B F ih=>simp [meterPairwise,pairwiseEmbeddings,ih]

theorem meterPairwise_polynomial (T : Tree) (F : Forest) (N : Nat)
 (tn : treeNodes T≤N) (tl : (leaves T).length≤N) (fl : F.length≤N)
 (blocks : ∀B∈F,B.length≤N) :
 (meterPairwise T F).work≤120*(N+1)^5 := by
 have h:=meterPairwise_bound T F (111*(N+1)^3)
   (fun B hb C hc=>meterHullPair_polynomial T B C N tn tl (blocks B hb) (blocks C hc))
 have pos : 1≤(N+1)^3:=Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)

def finalMeter (fee : CheckRequest→Nat) (T S : Tree) (a b : Nat) : CheckReceipt (Option FinalSelection) :=
 let l:=localMeter fee T S a b
 match l.value with
 | none=>⟨none,l.work+1,l.calls⟩
 | some .remaining=>let d:=selectBadMeter fee T S a b
  match d.value with
  | none=>⟨none,l.work+d.work+l.calls.length+2,l.calls++d.calls⟩

theorem final_work (fee : CheckRequest→Nat) (T S : Tree) (a b L K : Nat)
 (tlabs : ∀x,x∈leaves T →x<2^L) (slabs : ∀x,x∈leaves S →x<2^L)
 (primitive : ∀r,CheckDomain ((leaves T).length+(leaves S).length) L r →fee r≤K) :
 (finalMeter fee T S a b).work≤finalBudget (leaves T).length (leaves S).length K := by
 have l:=local_work fee T S a b L K tlabs slabs primitive
 have lc:=local_call_count fee T S a b ((leaves T).length+(leaves S).length) L (by omega) (by omega) tlabs slabs
 have d:=select_bad_work fee T S a b L K tlabs slabs primitive

theorem final_calls (fee : CheckRequest→Nat) (T S : Tree) (a b N L : Nat)
 (tcap : (leaves T).length≤N) (scap : (leaves S).length≤N)
 (tlabs : ∀x,x∈leaves T →x<2^L) (slabs : ∀x,x∈leaves S →x<2^L)
 {r : CheckRequest} (mem : r∈(finalMeter fee T S a b).calls) : CheckDomain N L r := by
 have loc:=local_calls fee T S a b N L tcap scap tlabs slabs (r:=r)
 have bad:=bad_candidates_calls fee T S a b N L tcap scap tlabs slabs (r:=r)
 simp only [finalMeter] at mem
